t: This is the William Pitt Byrne Memorial Fountain. It commemorates William Pitt Byrne, a British newspaper editor and the proprietor of The Morning Post, who died in 1861. The fountain was made by Julia Clara Byrne, a British writer of memoirs about celebrities of her time, and of more serious social commentary. I don't have more to tell you about the fountain itself, so take a moment to look at it and the water, and the tribute it makes.
